name: Offer of 3
acquisition: Clear a room whose door showed a god icon; god appears with 3 options
effect_paraphrased: Each god pickup shows 3 boons from that god's pool; pick one
synergy_partners: Door preview lets player choose which god's offer comes next
downside: Only 1 god per offer; you can't mix gods in one screen

name: Rarity tiers Common/Rare/Epic/Heroic
trigger_or_condition: Base chances: Rare 10% / Epic 5% (Heroic only via bonuses)
effect_paraphrased: Same boon, bigger number: Tier1 boons Rare x1.3-1.5, Epic x1.8-2.0, Heroic x2.3-2.5 of the Common value
scaling: Multiplier on base value; Pom levels stack on top
synergy_partners: Mirror talents and Chaos 'Favor' raise rare/epic odds
downside: Rarity only scales numbers; never changes behaviour

name: Legendary roll lane (shared by Duo + Legendary)
trigger_or_condition: Prerequisites satisfied; then 12% per slot base chance in this build
effect_paraphrased: Duo and Legendary boons only have a 'Legendary' rarity level, so they are drawn only when the Legendary roll succeeds
synergy_partners: Mirror talent God's Legacy (DuoRarityBoonDropMetaUpgrade) raises the chance
downside: Can't be forced; can go whole runs without one

name: Prerequisite gating (OneOf / OneFromEachSet)
acquisition: Automatic eligibility check before each offer
trigger_or_condition: Tier-2 boon needs one listed boon; Duo needs one boon from each of two (or three) sets; some Legendaries need two of three tier-2 boons
effect_paraphrased: Offer pool grows as your build grows; advanced boons never appear dead
synergy_partners: Signposted only after the fact: boon screen shows requirements in the Codex/Boon Info
downside: Players must memorise or look up requirement lists

name: PriorityChance signature boons
effect_paraphrased: Some tier-2 status boons (Static Discharge, Hunter's Mark, Blinding Flash, Razor Shoals) get a 50% chance to be force-inserted into the offer
synergy_partners: Pushes each god's status curse into builds early
downside: Crowds out other picks when it fires

name: Priority core-slot boons
effect_paraphrased: God offers favour Attack/Special/Dash/Cast slot boons (PriorityUpgrades list) so the god's status gets onto a main verb
synergy_partners: Slot boons are the prerequisites for most duos

name: Slot exclusivity
trigger_or_condition: Taking a new boon in an occupied slot
effect_paraphrased: Attack/Special/Cast/Dash/Call each hold one god's boon; a new one replaces the old
synergy_partners: Forces a choice about which god owns which verb

name: Exchange offer
acquisition: Any god offer after 2 completed runs
effect_paraphrased: Offer replaces another god's slot boon with this god's equivalent and carries over the old boon's Pom levels
synergy_partners: Lets a late god steal a slot without losing invested levels
downside: Can lure players into breaking a duo

name: Max 4 Olympians per run
effect_paraphrased: No new gods are offered once 4 have appeared (ReachedMaxGods, maxLootTypes = 4)
synergy_partners: Concentrates offers so duos become reachable
downside: Can lock out a wanted god early

name: Pom of Power
effect_paraphrased: Adds levels to an owned boon; each extra level adds less (default 0.7 decay per level, floor 10% of base; per-boon 'IdenticalMultiplier' tunes it)
scaling: Diminishing: ~+40% then +28% then +20% of base for a typical boon
downside: Players find it weak versus a new boon or hammer

name: Trial of the Gods
effect_paraphrased: Picking one god angers the other, who sends a harder encounter, then rewards a boon after you win
synergy_partners: Produces a second boon; can roll a duo

name: God keepsakes
effect_paraphrased: Each god's keepsake forces that god to appear next and increases its rarity
synergy_partners: Main tool for steering toward a specific duo

name: Hermes pool
effect_paraphrased: Speed, dash, dodge, ammo boons outside the slot system; own lower rarity table
synergy_partners: Rush Delivery converts speed into damage

name: Chaos Gate deal
effect_paraphrased: Each Chaos offer pairs a random curse lasting N encounters with a random permanent blessing that activates afterwards (3 offers)
downside: Curse can end a run if taken at the wrong time

name: Daedalus Hammer offer
effect_paraphrased: Rewrites how the equipped weapon's attack/special works; options filtered by mutual-exclusion lists

downside: Rare per run; Hades II players asked for hammer rerolls
